strategic_function: Show the product by showing the client. Anonymous micro-narratives replace services.

Each: 3–4 sentences before + brief after. No names, no 'Sara helped.' Transformation implied. Three-column cards, brand accent colors per card.

strategic_function: Explain why Sara's judgment is trustworthy. Not a CV — a cultural DNA map.
emotional_job: Fascination. How does someone become this?
notes: Identity word: культуролог. Five layers: 1. Azerbaijan — almond trees, hyper-generosity. 2. Moscow — institutional depth, right circles. 3. Los Angeles — pop, kitsch, тленка. 4. Paris — refined, best of the best. 5. Jewish/Kabbalah — beauty as spiritual practice. Closing: these coexist, the synthesis IS the product. Vertical progression, alternating alignment, ornament from each culture as transition markers.

strategic_function: Process explanation. Access, Independence, Navigation as experienced, not listed.
emotional_job: Clarity. I understand what working with her looks like.
notes: Three pillars as process: Access (top tier 1–2 calls away), Independence (can say no on your behalf, zero conflicts of interest), Navigation (speaks your language, treats confusion as industry's failure not yours). No hierarchy, no packages, no pricing. Ends with invitation not CTA button. Three equal columns, brand accent colors, pixel ornaments as dividers.
